venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Wednesday 7/8 (MOD MKZ/JK):** Hump Day in full effect. Slow start to the day, used to advantage for ABK and refreshing opening/closing SOPs (garnish freshness protocols, bathroom stocking and checks). Opener handled some weekend prep — the cast iron sour is officially back in house. Slow shift overall, but the closer used the time to detail the bar; gnats are ~95% gone after the drain cleaner did its job. Quiet shift but the team focused on making connections and sharing activations. Kitchen: slow day, thanks for helping FOH. Maintenance: gasket in cooler behind well 2 is completely apart from the door. Favorite moment: mostly first-timers in house. Comps $50.20. Net $1,096 vs. $1,312 target; 32 guests, $34.62 check avg.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Wednesday 7/8 (MOD MD / Chef KM):** Smooth Wednesday night. Steady service in the first three hours, followed by a lull beginning ~7pm — Claybon and Brandon used the time to get ahead on tomorrow's back-bar sidework and additional cleaning projects. Service picked back up ~10pm and continued to close. Kevin held down the kitchen and was present on the floor. 86: lassi mix, cider. Maintenance: well 3 chiller (to be seen tomorrow morning). Favorite moment: two young women visited for their second time — recent Atlanta transplants who call CC their “favorite bar” of either city and are excited to visit CC ATL. Comps $13.45 (0.8%, industry). Net $1,693 vs. $1,023 target; 55 guests, $30.79 check avg.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.weather: Another hot one with scattered showers after 3pm
venues.narrative: **DVR — Wednesday 7/8 (AM Maggie S / PM Maggie H):** Solid day as per usual. Cafe/AM $629.68 with one IRD; cold brew strained and put away, classic black tea to be made tomorrow. D&C PM $8,458.40 — steady night, nothing crazy. Garden/6A $2,232.41, Graham held it down all night. Kitchen: nice day, little pop mid-night, welcome back Marv; heavy prep lift tomorrow. Events: Day 2 of High School Success meetings, 25 guests 8am–3:30pm in Vauxhall with Josh's breakfast/lunch spread (all devoured); Day 3 tomorrow 8am–2pm ($3,329 event food / $3,654 net event). Comps $253. Favorite moment: a few great birthday celebrations and the event group closed us out for the second night in a row. Net $9,088.08 (excl. events) vs. $8,703 target; 161 guests; $12,742.08 including events.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Wednesday 7/8 (MOD Kyler / Chef Alejandro):** Busier-than-average Wednesday that kept the room light and buoyant even through usually slower hours. Many guests wanted multiple rounds and it read as an impressive first-date spot. Shoutout to Raj Patel and his fiancée, who got engaged today and came to celebrate their first-date spot. Top sellers: Cloudwalk, Rosalie, Native Lion. Door: full up by 6:30 and finished strong; many repeat guests and regulars, plus reps from Tromba, Jameson, and Rhine Hall. A disproportionately high number of solos led to some fun bar matchmaking (two solos left holding hands). Two no-shows (Graeme Gelbard 2 @ 10pm, Nshan Blikian 1 @ 10:15pm). Glassware: water glass, V martini. Comps $253.04 (4.8%, a few DNL, gifts, industry). Net $5,262 vs. $4,367 target; 152 guests, $35 check avg.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Wednesday 7/8 (MOD Gigi / Chef Vic):** Vibes were extra high as the evening kicked off with the Shareholder/Member Happy Hour. After resetting, a few groups stayed from the event and a few walk-ins sat at the bar. Streets were very quiet and the usual rush never quite arrived — lots of 1-tops and couples, a small handful of 4-tops; one group visiting from Denver loves D&C Denver, EV and now LA. Mitchell trained Ryan well and got prep and extra cleaning done; Bryson completed a 30-day review. Slow kitchen with a few waves of chicken and snacks. Event: another fun member Happy Hour — room filled quickly, many stayed to hang out, blinis with trout roe were a big hit, with Dave and Matt in to share the experience. Maintenance: oven (gas company tomorrow), kitchen light being fixed. Comps $93.80 (service recovery, gifts, investors/members). Net $3,344 vs. $5,105 target; 89 guests, $82.63 check avg.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.weather: Warm and humid, more foot traffic after sundown
venues.narrative: **DC — Wednesday 7/8 (MOD Marcus):** Slow start with very little traction until the sun went down — just a handful of two-tops around 7pm, so Mariah was cut at 8 and Marcus took over hosting. The room came to life around 9pm and was completely full by 10, briefly looking like a waitlist might start; the rush eased just as quickly, and by 11pm it was down to a two-top at the bar, a larger party in the Pod, and Khaleel's birthday at Table 44. Natural last call ~11:30, clear by 11:50. Shoutout to Devan for managing a full room, Jada and Elliot for swinging out to support, and Alex for seamless service. Great to welcome D&C DC alumni back — former host Khaleel for a friend's birthday and Eric for a nightcap. Maintenance: service entrance flooring loose, curtains coming off rails. Comps $28.65 (F&F). 73 guests (13 reso / 57 walk-in / 6 no-show / 2 cancel). Net $2,744.28 vs. $2,888 target, $37.08 check avg.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Wednesday 7/8 (AM Sam / PM Justin & Drew):** Very slow morning ($507, 25 guests); opening server cut when the noon arrived, one food tour, new rugs installed and looking great. Evening ($2,979, 70 guests): a pretty slow night handled by 2 servers and one bartender with full support, closing with a solo server and an SA in decent time; the bar was half full at its peak, 6 tables at peak on the floor — very manageable. Brittany completed her first training day (host stand with Skylar, then SA with Jack) and is fitting in well. Sun Club ($388) popping with hotel guests but the bar was chill; Hot Eye closed. Kitchen: slow with a couple of little pushes, no food returned, an easy night. Maintenance: rugs scotchgarded (recommend one can per rug next time), furniture displaced while rugs dry. Comps $221.40. Favorite moment: Sam from Hotel Granada joined for one last dinner before commuting back to Atlanta. Net $3,906 vs. $5,500 target; 95 guests.
